mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points within the last month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with sustained HOUST increases, or the correlation between HOUST growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last two months signals a contraction in supply, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate tightening monetary policy.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the positive economic news.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS and UNRATE on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the last three months indicates a strengthening consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with sustained RSAFS increases, or the correlation between RSAFS growth and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a supply-side contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
